articles.text: JEAN: No te comprometas para este domingo, Bob.
JEAN: Don't make any engagements for this Sunday, Bob.
BOB: ¿Por qué? Yo quiero ir otra vez a la corrida de toros.
BOB: Why? I want to go to the bullfights again.
JEAN: No puedes. Tenemos que llevar a los niños al campo.
JEAN: You can't. We have to take the children to the country.
BOB: Que vayan con la criada.
BOB: Let them go with the maid.
JEAN: No seas tan cruel. Ellos quieren ir con sus padres, no con la criada.
JEAN: Don't be so mean. They want to go with their parents, not with the maid.
